title: Secrets & Environment Key Management Architecture
requirements: Define .env.example documenting runtime keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
Implement .shared_orchestrator/config.py to validate and load credentials safely at runtime.
Ensure credential forwarding logic can inject environment variables into Docker containers without persisting secrets to images or git.
notes: Implemented .env.example, local .env with placeholder keys for DeepSeek and OpenAI, .shared_orchestrator/config.py with role model configs (DeepSeek for coding, OpenAI for orchestrator/planner/reviewer/product) and Docker env forwarding helpers. Added unit tests in tests/test_config.py; all tests passing.
